cast.title: Chicago
cast.overview: Murderesses Velma Kelly and Roxie Hart find themselves on death row together and fight for the fame that will keep them from the gallows in 1920s Chicago.

cast.title: The Way of the Gun
cast.overview: Two criminal drifters without sympathy get more than they bargained for after kidnapping and holding for ransom the surrogate mother of a powerful and shady man.

cast.title: Rent
cast.overview: In New York City's gritty East Village, a group of bohemians strive for success and acceptance while enduring the obstacles of poverty, illness and the AIDS epidemic.

cast.title: Basic
cast.overview: When a hurricane hits a US Army base on the edge of the Panama Canal, an elite covert operations team of US Army Rangers recruits are on a routine jungle training exercise that goes horribly awry. Only two recruits are rescued, one of which is badly injured, but both have different accounts regarding the fate of their leader, legendary and ruthless Army Ranger Drill Sergeant Nathan West, and the rest of their platoon. Tom Hardy, an ex-army Ranger turned maverick DEA agent is brought in to solve the mystery and uncover what really happened out there.

cast.title: House on Haunted Hill
cast.overview: An amusement park mogul offers a random group of diverse people $1 million to spend the night in a decrepit former mental institution.

cast.title: Equilibrium
cast.overview: In a dystopian future, a totalitarian regime maintains peace by subduing the populace with a drug, and displays of emotion are punishable by death. A man in charge of enforcing the law rises to overthrow the system.

cast.title: Cake
cast.overview: A travel writer improves her love life when she becomes an editor for her father's wedding magazine.

cast.title: Our Family Wedding
cast.overview: The weeks leading up to a young couple's wedding is comic and stressful, especially as their respective fathers try to lay to rest their feud.

cast.title: Go
cast.overview: A supermarket clerk decides to step in for an absent drug dealer, setting off an explosive, comedic chain of events.

cast.title: How Stella Got Her Groove Back
cast.original_title: How Stella Got Her Groove Back
cast.overview: Through good times and bad, Stella and Delilah have always had each other. Now, Stella's so busy building a life that she's forgotten how to really live. But Delilah is about to change all that. What starts as a quick trip to Jamaica, ends as an exhilarating voyage of self discovery as Stella learns to open her heart and find love – even if it's with a man 20 years her junior.

cast.title: Malibu's Most Wanted
cast.overview: A senator arranges for his son, a rich white kid who fancies himself black, to be kidnapped by a couple of black actors pretending to be murderers to try and shock him out of his plans to become a rapper.

cast.title: The Black Pack: We Three Kings
cast.original_title: The Black Pack: We Three Kings
cast.overview: Taye Diggs, Ne-Yo and Eric Bellinger bring holiday music -- both new and old -- to life on stage, providing a new spin on an old-fashioned Christmas.

cast.title: Drum
cast.overview: A hot-shot journalist is swept up in a movement to challenge Apartheid in 1950s South Africa.

cast.title: New Best Friend
cast.overview: Alicia is a poor girl starting college. Hadley, Julianne and Sydney are three well-off girls in a row house. Classes begin and Alicia is paired with Hadley to work on a sociology class project. At first rejected, Alicia is finally accepted into Hadley's clique where she is introduced to a world of privilege and dangerous thrills. But her attempts to become one of them ultimately land her in the hospital.

cast.title: Dylan Dog: Dead of Night
cast.overview: Supernatural private eye, Dylan Dog, seeks out the monsters of the Louisiana bayou in his signature red shirt, black jacket and blue jeans.

cast.title: The Wood
cast.overview: In the panicky, uncertain hours before his wedding, a groom with prenuptial jitters and his two best friends reminisce about growing up together in the middle-class African-American neighborhood of Inglewood, California. Flashing back to the twenty-something trio's childhood exploits, the memories capture the mood and nostalgia of the '80s era.

cast.title: The Best Man
cast.overview: After writing a soon-to-be bestselling novel, writer and committed bachelor Harper attempts to hide the fact that his saucy new book is loosely based on the lives and loves of his tight-knit group of friends. Harper is set to be best man at his friend Lance's wedding, and all his friends will be in attendance. When an advance copy of the book makes its way into the hands of his ex-flame, Jordan, Harper attempts to keep it under wraps.

cast.title: Brown Sugar
cast.overview: Sidney and Dre can attribute their lifelong friendship and the launch of their careers to one single childhood instant... witnessing the birth of hip-hop on a New York street corner. Now some 15 years later, she is a revered music critic at a national magazine and he is a successful, though unfulfilled, hip-hop record company executive. Both come to realize that their true life passions will only be fulfilled by remembering what they learned that day on the corner.

cast.title: 30 Days
cast.overview: Two star basketball players, Donnell, a black kid from the inner city high school, and Jason, a white kid from the affluent suburbs, are sentenced to 30 days of labour in each other's communities after a brawl between their two teams. When they return to their home turf, both see their new attitudes put to the test.

cast.title: Celebrity Mix
cast.overview: These eight short films range from hysterically funny to wickedly suspenseful, and feature some of Hollywood's biggest names. Includes short films Laud Weiner, House Hunting, Curiosity, Dysenchanted, Dependable People, Media Whore, Walking Dreams, Mr. Dramatic.

cast.title: Incarnation
cast.overview: Brad and Jess move to Los Angeles in search of a better life. When they stumble upon a hidden real estate gem, managed by the laid-back landlord Peter, they are elated by their turn of fortune. But their ideal home is hiding a secret far more sinister than they could have ever imagined, for the very walls are alive with an ancient evil, and they soon learn that greed comes with a hefty price.

cast.title: Media Whore
cast.overview: Meet Astrid. Proof that anyone can be on TV. Anyone.

cast.title: Days of Wrath
cast.overview: The lives of rival gang members, a teacher, a TV news crew and other intertwine in the city of Los Angeles.

cast.title: The Best Man Holiday
cast.overview: When college friends reunite after 15 years over the Christmas holidays, they discover just how easy it is for long-forgotten rivalries and romances to be reignited.

cast.title: The Comeback
cast.overview: Jeff and Tisa Murray have decided to move their family back to their hometown of Atlanta when Tisa is offered her dream job. The dream becomes a hilarious reality when family issues, Mom’s new boyfriend, and ex-lovers are waiting on them upon their return.

cast.title: No Day But Today: The Story of 'Rent'
cast.original_title: No Day But Today: The Story of 'Rent'
cast.overview: Feature length documentary about Jonathan Larson and "Rent"'s journey from Broadway to the screen. Featuring director Chris Columbus, the entire cast, and dozens of friends and family of Jonathan Larson.

cast.title: Baggage Claim
cast.overview: Although she has traveled all over the world, flight attendant Montana Moore has yet to find a man with whom she wants to settle down. However, with her sister's upcoming wedding and pressure from her oft-married mother, she's determined to get engaged in the next 30 days. In that time, her best friends (and fellow flight attendants) conspire to help her re-encounter her exes as she flies all over the country.

cast.title: The Black Pack: Excellence
cast.overview: Features special guests to commemorate Juneteenth and celebrate Black excellence and culture with musical and dance performances.

cast.title: Love & Murder: Atlanta Playboy
cast.overview: Follows Lance, a prominent Atlanta businessman known for both revamping the city's 911 system and his proclivity for women. There are many theories and claims about who would have wished him dead when he is discovered dead in his own home.

cast.title: The Trials of Cate McCall
cast.overview: In order to be reinstated to the bar and recover custody of her daughter, a hotshot lawyer, now in recovery and on probation, must take on the appeal of a woman wrongfully convicted of murder.

cast.title: Sesame Street: Play All Day with Elmo!
cast.original_title: Sesame Street: Play All Day with Elmo!
cast.overview: Come Play with Elmo! Everyone's favorite furry red friend is joined by all kinds of kids to play Elmo Says, Red Light Green Light, Freeze Dance, Pat-a-cake and more. OK Go mix primary colors into a rainbow and Taye Diggs helps Elmo pretend in this playful special featuring singing, dancing, and learning!

cast.title: Opening Night
cast.overview: A failed Broadway singer who now works as a production manager must save opening night on his new production by wrangling his eccentric cast and crew.

cast.title: Britney Spears: Greatest Hits - My Prerogative
cast.original_title: Britney Spears: Greatest Hits - My Prerogative
cast.overview: One of the biggest pop stars in the world, Britney Spears released this collection of 20 music videos to coincide with the unveiling of her greatest-hits album of the same name. Among the songs on Britney Spears: Greatest Hits -- My Prerogative are "I'm Not a Girl, Not Yet a Woman," "Don't Let Me Be the Last to Know," "Oops!...I Did It Again," and "From the Bottom of My Broken Heart."

cast.title: My Little Pony: The Movie
cast.overview: A new dark force threatens Ponyville, and the Mane 6 – Twilight Sparkle, Applejack, Rainbow Dash, Pinkie Pie, Fluttershy and Rarity – embark on an unforgettable journey beyond Equestria where they meet new friends and exciting challenges on a quest to use the magic of friendship and save their home.

cast.title: Forever
cast.overview: When a veteran returns to his hometown, he unexpectedly falls head over heels for a local policewoman. He’s determined to win her heart… but to do so, he must also win the approval of her three teenage daughters. It’s been a long time since he’s had people to call family, and now–home for the first time in years–he must let go of any regret or grudges he’s held onto so that he can find love and learn the true meaning of family for the first time.

cast.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
cast.overview: Michael and Madison Roland planned to spend the rest of their lives together, but Michael's controlling ways turn their perfect marriage into an abusive roller-coaster ride that no woman could survive. With the help of her best friend, Madison fakes her death to escape and start a new life — but soon realizes it's impossible to outwit her obsessive husband.

cast.title: Set It Up
cast.overview: Two overworked and underpaid assistants come up with a plan to get their bosses off their backs by setting them up with each other.

cast.title: Abby Singer
cast.overview: Chronicles the life of Curtis Clemins, who is torn between the love of his life and accomplishing his dream. When hitting rock bottom during the Sundance Film Festival, Clemins' calls upon his old college chum, Kevin Prouse, giving the now drunken acting instructor in the throes of a divorce, the only clue that will salvage Clemins' rapidly deteriorating life.

cast.title: Black Panther
cast.overview: Black Panther is the ruler and protector of the African nation of Wakanda. Using technology, wits, and extraordinary fighting ability he must protect his nation from an invasion led by Ulysses Klaw, the man who killed his father.

cast.title: Idina Menzel Live: Barefoot at the Symphony
cast.original_title: Idina Menzel Live: Barefoot at the Symphony
cast.overview: The stage musical star, also known for her appearances in the popular TV show, 'Glee', captured live in performance in Toronto with the backing of the Kitchener-Waterloo Symphony. Menzel performed a number of songs from stage musicals and popular classical pieces in Koerner Hall, part of Toronto's Royal Conservatory of Music, with the support of conductor Marvin Hamlisch, pianist Rob Mounsey and the 52-piece symphony.

cast.title: River Runs Red
cast.overview: When the son of a successful judge is killed by two police officers and the system sets them free, a hardened veteran detective finds some incriminating files on the officers and the judge teams up with another mourning father to take the law into his own hands.

cast.title: Rent
cast.overview: The story of several friends in New York City facing financial poverty, homophobia, AIDS, and, of course, rent.

cast.title: Slow Burn
cast.overview: A district attorney is involved in a 24-hour showdown with a gang leader and is, at the same time, being manipulated by an attractive assistant district attorney and a cryptic stranger.

cast.title: Still Laugh-In: The Stars Celebrate
cast.overview: Hollywood's finest pay tribute to "Rowan and Martin's Laugh-In" for an uncensored and unforgettable celebration at The Dolby Theater.

cast.title: Larry Gaye: Renegade Male Flight Attendant
cast.original_title: Larry Gaye: Renegade Male Flight Attendant
cast.overview: A self-anointed 'renegade' male flight attendant must save the day when the airline he works for tries to eliminate flight attendants as a cost-cutting measure.

cast.title: The Trials of Cate McCall
cast.overview: In order to be reinstated to the bar and recover custody of her daughter, a hotshot lawyer, now in recovery and on probation, must take on the appeal of a woman wrongfully convicted of murder.

cast.title: Just a Kiss
cast.overview: A group of thirtysomethings having problems with fidelity gets an opportunity to turn back the clock.

cast.title: Between Us
cast.overview: A New York couple and their Midwestern friends find that drastic changes have occurred in their respective lives since they last met.

cast.title: BFFs
cast.overview: Two best friends play practical jokes on each other until things get out of hand.

cast.title: Both Eyes Open
cast.overview: Ally escapes an abusive relationship but hallucinates about her abuser. She receives cryptic messages suggesting he's nearby. As the messages intensify and her reality unravels, Ally realizes the truth may be closer than she thought.

cast.title: The Real Full Monty
cast.overview: A daring group of male celebrities volunteer to bare all to raise awareness for prostate and testicular cancer testing and research.

cast.title: I'll Be Home for National Margarita Day
cast.original_title: I'll Be Home for National Margarita Day
cast.overview: When a big-city developer threatens a town holiday tradition, exes Liz and Sam must team up to stop him.

cast.title: Another Man's Wife
cast.overview: A millionaire makes a shocking offer to a married couple in crisis, who are financially devastated and caring for a terminally ill parent. What begins as an act of survival spirals into a high-stakes emotional reckoning about trust, love and the ultimate cost of sacrifice.

cast.title: Terry McMillan Presents: His, Hers & Ours
cast.original_title: Terry McMillan Presents: His, Hers & Ours
cast.overview: Forced to spend time together due to their teenage children’s relationship, a secret romance between Darius and Kelly blossoms, stealing moments at family gatherings and behind closed doors.

cast.title: Stepfather
cast.overview: After years of eradicating any family that falls short of perfection, Darnell believes his new wife Asia and her daughters might finally be the real deal. That is, until tensions rise and they uncover his deadly pattern. Now, getting rid of them won’t be as easy as he planned.

cast.title: Forever, This Ring
cast.overview: Maveric Collins, a successful entrepreneur and playboy, has promised to never get married — until he meets the woman of his dreams and changes his mind. But when they get married, he finds out she’s actually not who he thought she was. “Will the woman he once loved go away calmly, or will this end in a deadly divorce?”

cast.title: Syndetic
cast.overview: Richard Thompson is a former Marine and network administrator whose unemployment, addiction, and estrangement from his two sons leave him vulnerable to an unusual offer from Neural Hive. There, the disarmingly genial Dr. Carnegie recruits Richard into an experimental program that uses human brains as individual nodes within a distributed computing network designed to harness the mind’s capacity for prediction and pattern recognition. As Richard begins experiencing violent images and unfamiliar memories that undermine his sense of identity and reality, he becomes increasingly consumed by Kylie O'Reilly, a ubiquitous motivational media personality whose relentless optimism takes on a more invasive and unsettling significance.

cast.title: Rent: 30th Anniversary Concert
cast.overview: Original cast members and a bevy of special guests revive the Tony Award- and Pulitzer Prize-winning rock musical sensation Rent in a gala concert celebration for the show’s 30th anniversary. The one-night-only concert of the full show will take place on Monday, October 26, at Broadway’s Richard Rodgers Theatre as a benefit for Broadway Cares/Equity Fights AIDS.
